title: Your first tunes
goal: Play Hot Cross Buns and Mary Had a Little Lamb with your right hand.

steps.title: Hot Cross Buns
steps.text: An old street song that uses only three notes: E, D and C. Thumb on C, then 2 on D and 3 on E.

steps.title: Hot Cross Buns, slowly
steps.text: Play each lit key. The song waits for you.

steps.title: With the click
steps.text: Now the tune keeps time and clicks the beat. Play on the clicks.

steps.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
steps.text: Another tune everybody knows. It reaches up to G with your little finger (5), so keep your hand in its C position.

steps.title: Mary, slowly
steps.text: The first four lines of the tune.

steps.title: Mary with the click
steps.text: The same tune again, in time with the clicks.
